address: Laan van Roos en Doorn 51a, The Hague, 2514 BC, Netherlands
bio: Calla, both a Mexican flower and the Greek word for beauty, perfectly captures the serene feel of this elegant restaurant. In both the champagne lounge and the dining room, the decor is stylish, with decorative flowers adding a touch of warmth. Ronald van Roon puts great emphasis on vegetables in his dishes, picking up a fresh supply from Laantje Voorham vegetable garden every day. The meticulous chef likes to combine his harvest with other top-notch ingredients that he prepares as simply as possible to let their natural flavours shine through. He is unwavering when it comes to his cooking methods and choice of produce; it is the garnishes that bring variety.
